Eligible Hosting Services

The 30-day money-back guarantee applies to all new purchases of Cloud NVMe Hosting, Premium cPanel Hosting, Reseller WHM Hosting, and Specialized WordPress/Node.js Hosting plans.

Non-Refundable Items

Domain name registrations/transfers, SSL certificates, dedicated IP add-ons, and software licenses (cPanel/WHM/LiteSpeed) are non-refundable as they incur direct registry third-party fees.

How to Request a Refund

To request a refund within 30 days of initial order activation, simply open a ticket with our billing department via the client portal. Refunds are processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
